notes.title: Patch Notes v1.2.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631268/dd5420ce89545a2791f063781bed5fe094341fd7.jpg[/img]

Dear Friends,

here are the patch notes for v1.2.1 of Across the Grooves:
— Dual Sense controllers support. Your PlayStation 5 gamepads should now work correctly both via USB and Bluetooth.
— Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor was disabled when playing on a touchscreen equipped Windows device,
— Fixed a music bug where the audio for the song sequence in chapter 1 would not start (big thanks to Steam users Grumpelstiltskin and Talae who helped us pinpoint the issue).

Please note that our Twitch integration beta has been disabled. Unfortunately, Twitch completely changed its token system, rendering the feature unusable for the time being.

If you're interested in Twitch integration, please reach out to us, we will consider devoting some of humble resources to make it work again if there's enough demand.

Thank you and kind regards,

Geoffroy,
on behalf of the team.

notes.title: Patch Notes (v1.2.0) — Ready for the Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631268/74726f349b98ec2d75c1807f14de46967ff9dd22.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

We're very glad to announce that [b]Across the Grooves[/b] is now ready for the Steam Deck!

We implemented the requirements and recommendations for the new device, and we now support the new "Dynamic Cloud Save", allowing the players to suspend their game and pick it up where they left off on another device.

Here are the [b]patch notes[/b]:
[list][*] Dynamic Cloud Save support,
[*] Support of Xbox One / Xbox Series controller icons on all platforms,
[*] Overall performance optimizations and under the hood upgrades,
[*] Various bug fixes.[/list]

Cheers!

Geoffroy,
on behalf of the team.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631268/13c875f1ae2e7517f29e8e0e4543790dd35e5796.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

We just updated Across the Grooves to the version "v1.1.1".

Here's the list changes:
[list]
[*] Gamepad Tutorial: fixed the button map (labels for "South" and "East" buttons were inverted),
[*] Story: fixed a narrative path where Frank would mention the record while Alice didn't tell him about it (in Chapter 2),
[*] Story: fixed a duplicate sentence in Chapter 4,
[*] South American Spanish localization: various fixes and polish (thanks again, Ariel!),
[*] Various typos fixes,
[*] Various bug fixes, stability and optimization improvements.
[/list]

Enjoy!

All the best,

Geoffroy,
on behalf of the team.
